title: LLaVA-Critic: Learning to Evaluate Multimodal Models
authors_zh: Tianyi Xiong、Xiyao Wang、Dong Guo、Qinghao Ye、Haoqi Fan、Quanquan Gu、Heng Huang、Chunyuan Li
paper_type_zh: 多模态通用评审模型与 critic 指令数据集
best_for_zh: 需要视觉语言 judge、带理由的评估监督或多模态偏好训练数据的研究者
one_line: LLaVA-Critic releases 113,000 multimodal evaluation records—scores, preference pairs, and rationales—to train an open generalist vision-language evaluator.
LLaVA-Critic-113k 含 46K 图像、113K 评分或成对偏好及理由，覆盖多种视觉任务，可用于多模态 judge 与偏好训练。
why: It combines criterion-following scoring, pairwise preference, and rationale generation in one open multimodal critic dataset.
inclusion_reason: LLaVA-Critic publicly releases multimodal critic instruction and preference data for evaluation and alignment.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal evaluation has long relied on closed GPT-4-family judges or task-specific metrics, making it costly and hard to reproduce or convert directly into preference signals. Open VLMs generally learn to answer rather than systematically learning evaluation criteria and rationales across visual tasks.

LLaVA-Critic builds critic instruction data spanning diverse tasks and criteria and trains an open generalist multimodal evaluator that produces scores and rationales, performs pairwise comparisons, and supplies reward signals for preference learning.

多模态模型评测长期依赖 GPT-4 系列闭源 judge 或任务专用指标，成本高、不可复现，也难以将评分直接转为偏好训练信号；现有开源 VLM 通常只学习生成回答，没有系统学习跨视觉任务的评价准则和理由。

LLaVA-Critic 构建覆盖多任务、多准则的 critic instruction data，训练一个开源通用多模态评价器，使其既能输出评分与理由，也能进行成对比较，并把判断转为偏好学习奖励。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: LLaVA-Critic builds critic instruction data spanning diverse tasks and criteria and trains an open generalist multimodal evaluator that produces scores and rationales, performs pairwise comparisons, and supplies reward signals for preference learning. LLaVA-Critic-113K contains about 46K images and 113K critic-instruction examples spanning scoring, pairwise preference, evaluation rationales, and diverse visual tasks. A record typically includes an image, task or question, one or two candidate responses, evaluation criteria, a score or preference, and a rationale. The official Hugging Face release supports critic SFT and multimodal preference learning.

LLaVA-Critic 构建覆盖多任务、多准则的 critic instruction data，训练一个开源通用多模态评价器，使其既能输出评分与理由，也能进行成对比较，并把判断转为偏好学习奖励。LLaVA-Critic-113K 包含约 46K 幅图像和 113K 条 critic 指令实例，覆盖评分、成对偏好、评价理由及多种视觉任务。单条通常包含图像、问题或任务、一个或两个候选回答、评价准则、分数/偏好和 rationale；官方 Hugging Face 数据用于 critic SFT 与多模态偏好学习。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Collect images, requests, and candidate model responses from visual QA, reasoning, description, generation, and evaluation tasks.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Design task-specific scoring or comparison criteria and use strong judges to generate scores, chosen/rejected labels, and natural-language rationales.
  1. Verify and filter: Apply rule checks, format normalization, and quality filtering to unify pointwise and pairwise data as critic-instruction records.
  1. Train and evaluate: Supervise a LLaVA-based model to obtain LLaVA-Critic, then use its scores or preferences to train other multimodal policies and evaluate it on judge benchmarks.

1. 建立数据源： 从多种视觉问答、推理、描述和生成评测任务中收集图像、请求与候选模型回答。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 为不同任务设计评分或比较准则，并使用强 judge 生成分数、chosen/rejected 标签与自然语言评价理由。
  1. 验证与筛选： 执行规则检查、格式标准化和质量筛选，将 pointwise 与 pairwise 样本统一成 critic instruction records。
  1. 训练与评测： 在 LLaVA 架构上做 SFT 得到 LLaVA-Critic，再用其分数或偏好训练其他多模态 policy，并在 judge benchmark 上验证。

title: Evidence
证据
html: LLaVA-Critic matches or exceeds GPT models on several LMM-as-a-Judge evaluations and supplies useful rewards in preference-learning experiments, improving aligned multimodal models. The results show that an open 7B-scale critic can serve as a general visual evaluator, although performance remains tied to the quality of synthetic judge labels. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.
LLaVA-Critic 在多项 LMM-as-a-Judge 评测上达到或超过 GPT 模型，并在偏好学习实验中提供有效 reward，使被训练的多模态模型对齐性能提高。结果说明开放 7B 级 critic 可以承担通用视觉评审，但论文表现仍受合成 judge 标签质量影响。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier open multimodal evaluators were often benchmark-specific or scalar-only. LLaVA-Critic learns pointwise, pairwise, and rationale outputs across tasks in one critic-instruction format and uses the same model for automatic evaluation and preference learning.
此前开源多模态 evaluator 多针对单一 benchmark 或只输出 scalar；LLaVA-Critic 的变化是用统一 critic instruction format 跨任务学习 pointwise、pairwise 与 rationale，并将同一模型同时用于自动评价和 preference learning。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: Many labels are produced by strong models and inherit their visual blind spots, style preferences, and positional bias.
  1. Feedback risk: The 113K records mix tasks and annotation formats and should not be interpreted as 113K independent preference pairs.
  1. Reproduction and use: Image licences follow upstream sources, and deployment as a benchmark judge requires calibration on a hidden human-labeled set.

1. 覆盖边界： 大量标签由强模型生成，会继承闭源 judge 的视觉盲点、风格偏好和位置偏差。
  1. 反馈风险： 113K 是不同任务与标注形式的混合集，不能把记录数直接理解为 113K 个独立 pair。
  1. 复现与使用： 图像许可继承上游数据源；部署为 benchmark judge 前还需在人工隐藏集上校准。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Train an open multimodal judge that returns scores, preferences, and rationales.
  1. Training: Generate rewards for visual DPO or Best-of-N while periodically checking bias against human preferences.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Study pointwise versus pairwise supervision with the 113K data; add task-specific verifiers when pixel or executable correctness matters.

1. 评测： 训练开源多模态 judge，输出评分、偏好和评价理由。
  1. 训练： 为视觉 DPO 或 Best-of-N 生成 reward，但要定期用人工偏好检查偏差。
  1. 迁移或部署： 以 113K 数据研究 pointwise 与 pairwise 监督差异；若任务要求像素或执行正确性，应额外加入专用 verifier。
